newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain cabinet will not seal reforms today - source.
newsitem.headline: Spain cabinet will not seal reforms today - source.

text.p: Spain's cabinet will not approve any liberalisation measures at its weekly meeting today as widely expected, a government source said on Friday.
Instead discussions will centre on the extradition of a number of suspected ETA members from France, aid to Spanish fisherman and training at military bases.
Last week, the cabinet studied a package of liberalisation measures aimed at boosting economic growth. They said some of the measures would be approved in upcoming meetings.
Final approval of the sale of the state's remaining 10 percent stake in energy group Repsol would also not be studied this week as was previously expected.
